blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several roads will be closed in the city of Manila starting Saturday evening, Nov. 28, ahead of a road running event.According to the Manila Public Information Office, the following roads will be closed from 9 p.m. onwards on Saturday due to the AIA Rock and Roll Series Manila on Sunday, Nov. 29: Due to this, the Manila government advised motorists to take the rerouted routes: The AIA Rock and Roll Series Manila is an annual road-running event which combines long-distance running with live music, DJs, and on-course entertainment. /ms...
